teaser.en: To the Digo, the passion fruit vine is simply 'the fruit plant'.
teaser.sw: Kwa Wadigo, mkarakara ni 'mmea wa tunda' tu.
teaser.dg: Kpwa Adigo, mmea hinyu unaokpwera wa *passion fruit* ni 'mmea wa matunda' tu.

summary.en: Mtunda is the passion fruit, a climbing vine from South America grown in coastal homesteads for its tangy, seedy fruit. Its Digo name is built from tunda, fruit.
summary.sw: Mtunda ni mkarakara, mtambaa kutoka Amerika Kusini unaopandwa katika makazi ya pwani kwa ajili ya matunda yake yenye ladha ya uchachu na mbegu nyingi. Jina lake la Kidigo limejengwa kutokana na tunda.
summary.dg: *Mtunda* ni *passion fruit*, mmea unaokpwera wa kula Amerika ya Kusini, unaophandwa midzini pwani kpwa sababu ya matundage ga ngbwadu-ngbwadu genye tembe nyinji. Dzinare ra Chidigo rikahendwa kula neno *tunda*.

about.en: Mtunda is a vigorous woody climber that holds on with coiled tendrils. Its leaves are glossy and deeply three-lobed. The flowers are intricate and beautiful, white with a crown of wavy purple-and-white filaments. The round fruit, about the size of a hen's egg, ripens purple or yellow and is filled with juicy, aromatic pulp around small black seeds.
about.sw: Mtunda ni mtambaa wenye nguvu na shina gumu, unaoshika kwa vikonyo vilivyojikunja. Majani yake yanang'aa na yana mapengo matatu marefu. Maua yake ni tata na mazuri, meupe yakiwa na taji la nyuzi zilizopindapinda za zambarau na nyeupe. Tunda la mviringo, lenye ukubwa wa yai la kuku, huiva likiwa la zambarau au la manjano na limejaa nyama yenye maji mengi na harufu nzuri inayozunguka mbegu ndogo nyeusi.
about.dg: *Mtunda* ni mmea unaokpwera wenye nguvu na wa mbao, unaogbwira kpwa vigongo vyembamba vinavyodzizunguluka. Makodzage ganang'arira na gana mala mahahu. Maruwa ni ga ajabu na manono, mereru na ganakala na taji ya nyuzi za zambarau na nyereru, dza mawimbi. Tunda ra duara, sawa na tumbi ra kuku, rinaivwa richikala ra zambarau au ra rangi ya mandano, na ndani rinaodzala nyama-nyama ya madzi-madzi yenye arufu nono, iriyozunguluka tembe ndide nyiru.

where.en: It is native to South America and is now grown across the tropics. On the coast it is trained over fences, trees and frames around homesteads and on small farms.
where.sw: Asili yake ni Amerika Kusini na sasa hupandwa kote katika nchi za tropiki. Pwani, hutambazwa juu ya ua, miti na fremu kuzunguka makazi na kwenye mashamba madogo.
where.dg: Asiliye ni Amerika ya Kusini, na sambi unaphandwa kosi kpwenye tsi za dzoho. Pwani nkukpwezwa dzulu ya chigo, mihi na vibao kanda-kanda ya midzi na kpwenye minda midide.

uses.en: The pulp is eaten fresh and made into juice. Passion fruit is a popular fruit for drinks on the Kenyan coast and is also sold in local markets.
uses.sw: Nyama yake huliwa kama ilivyo na hutengenezwa sharubati. Karakara ni tunda linalopendwa kwa vinywaji pwani ya Kenya na pia huuzwa katika masoko ya mitaani.
uses.dg: Nyama-nyama nkuriwa dza irivyo na nkuhendwa madzi ga matunda. *Passion fruit* ni tunda rinaromendzwa sana kpwa vinwadzi pwani ya Kenya, na piya nkuguzwa kpwenye masoko ga kahi ya tsi.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name Mtunda for the passion fruit. Pakia's appendices use tunda as the Digo word for fruit, so the name means something like 'fruit plant'. In Swahili the plant is mkarakara and the fruit karakara or pasheni. Its scientific name is Passiflora edulis.
names.sw: Pakia anarekodi jina la Kidigo Mtunda kwa mkarakara. Viambatisho vya Pakia vinatumia tunda kama neno la Kidigo la tunda, hivyo jina hili lina maana kama 'mmea wa tunda'. Kwa Kiswahili mmea huu ni mkarakara na tunda ni karakara au pasheni. Jina lake la kisayansi ni Passiflora edulis.
names.dg: Pakia anaandika dzina ra Chidigo *Mtunda* kpwa *passion fruit*. Nyongeza za Pakia zinahumira *tunda* dza neno ra Chidigo ra 'tunda', kpwa hivyo dzina hiri rina mana dza 'mmea wa matunda'. Kpwa Chiswahili mmea unaihwa *mkarakara* na tunda *karakara* au *pasheni*. Dzinare ra chisayansi ni *Passiflora edulis*.

reason.en: Adenia, a wild relative in the passion-flower family
reason.sw: Adenia, jamaa wa porini katika familia ya mkarakara
reason.dg: *Adenia*, ndugu wa weruni wa jamii ya *passion flower*

reason.en: Another climber of the passion-flower family
reason.sw: Mtambaa mwingine wa familia ya mkarakara
reason.dg: Mmea wanjina unaokpwera wa jamii ya *passion flower*

reason.en: Another introduced fruit of the homestead
reason.sw: Mpera, tunda lingine la nyumbani lililoletwa kutoka nje
reason.dg: Muhi wanjina mjeni wa matunda wa midzini
